summary: Hungary's government scholarship funds thousands of international students each year at bachelor's, master's and doctoral level. Tuition is free, housing is provided or subsidised, and there is a monthly stipend — although at bachelor's and master's level it is only a contribution to living costs.
covers: Tuition-free study at a Hungarian university.
A monthly stipend of HUF 43,700 (about €110) for bachelor's, master's and one-tier master's students, paid 12 months a year.
Doctoral students receive HUF 140,000 a month (about €355) in the first four semesters and HUF 180,000 (about €460) in the last four.
A free dormitory place, or HUF 40,000 a month towards rent.
Medical insurance under Hungarian rules plus supplementary cover of up to HUF 65,000 a year.
eligibility: Citizens of countries with an educational cooperation agreement with Hungary. Your country's 'sending partner' (usually a ministry) must nominate you.
Each sending partner sets its own rules — such as age limits, eligible levels and fields — so read your country's page on the Stipendium Hungaricum site.
Applicants must meet the entrance requirements of the programmes they choose; many are taught in English.
how_to_apply: Between November and December, choose up to two programmes and read your sending partner's requirements.
Submit the online application by the deadline — for 2026/27 it was 15 January 2026 at 2 pm CET — and apply through your sending partner if it runs its own process.
In February, sending partners nominate candidates; between March and May, universities hold entrance exams or interviews.
Results are announced in June for a September start.
watch_out: The stipend is deliberately described as only a contribution to living expenses. At about €110 a month, you will need savings or support to live comfortably.
Some sending partners have their own earlier deadlines or extra forms. Missing their step disqualifies you even if the main form is submitted.
Nomination by your sending partner does not guarantee a place; the university's entrance exam decides.
